items.name: biscotti-foundation
items.title: Biscotti UI foundation
items.description: Tokens (CSS variables + Tailwind v4 theme), motion springs, the synthesised sound engine, utilities, primitives and icons.

items.name: action-toolbar
items.title: Contextual Action Toolbar
items.description: A floating toolbar that follows the text selection and morphs into an inline input.

items.name: activity-stack
items.title: Agent Activity Stack
items.description: Concurrent agent tasks that sort by urgency and sink into a deck of finished work.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Human Approval Card
items.description: An agent asks before it acts. Decide, and the card folds into a receipt you can undo.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K search over commands, with fuzzy ranking, nested pages and async results.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Smart Data Table
items.description: Sort, inspect, and act on live records without losing your place.

items.name: diff-inspector
items.title: Interactive Diff Inspector
items.description: Review proposed edits hunk by hunk. Accepted changes settle into the document.

items.name: filter-builder
items.title: Visual Filter Builder
items.description: Build readable filters with typed editors, editable clauses, and live results.

items.name: insight-card
items.title: Insight Card
items.description: A KPI with rolling digits, a scrubbable SVG chart and an insight sentence worth reading.

items.name: interactive-slider
items.title: Interactive Slider
items.description: A precision fader with a measuring ruler, magnetic notches and fine adjust.

items.name: kinetic-button
items.title: Kinetic Button
items.description: A button family that presses physically and narrates its own async lifecycle.

items.name: mention-picker
items.title: Contextual Mention Picker
items.description: Find people, files and tools at the caret, then insert a reference as one token.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notification & Feedback System
items.description: Stacked toasts with undo countdowns, in-place progress and a persistent Callout.

items.name: precision-toggle
items.title: Precision Toggle
items.description: A latching switch that stays in pencil until the change is actually saved.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Intelligent Prompt Composer
items.description: Compose a prompt with file uploads, inline references and slash commands.

items.name: property-editor
items.title: Inline Property Editor
items.description: An inspector with scrubbable numbers, a colour picker and a box model you drag directly.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A segmented control whose indicator inchworms — lead edge first, trailing edge after.

items.name: streaming-response
items.title: Streaming Response
items.description: Renders a real text stream as light markdown, with chunk fades, citations and a pencil caret.

items.name: thinking-timeline
items.title: Thinking Timeline
items.description: An agent's progress as user-facing steps that shrink into a past-tense summary.

items.name: tool-chip
items.title: Tool Execution Chip
items.description: One quiet inline chip per tool call that opens in place into its input and output.

items.name: workflow-stepper
items.title: Workflow Stepper
items.description: A multi-step run drawn as dependency lanes that split, run in parallel and merge.
